title: API keys left in public Docker images are abused within seconds
content_md:
Anyone who accidentally leaves API keys in public Docker images is punished immediately: in the test, attackers accessed them in some cases in under eight seconds...

via Mastodon https://winfuture.de/news,162748.html?utm_source=Mastodon&utm_medium=ManualStatus&utm_campaign=SocialMedia
